name: MEA Local — Extracted Order Service (Quarkus)
_comment: FORWARD-REFERENCE (order-plan.md S4+, not yet exercised by S2): points the SAME behavior-equivalence suite at the extracted Quarkus Order service (examples/07-order-service/) once it exists, on its own port (:8087) so it can run side-by-side with the monolith during the strangler cutover (order-plan S8). The collection's 'Order Context Contract' folder (added at S2, DRQ-071) targets {{baseUrl}}, same as every other folder — not this file directly — so it runs correctly against the monolith (:8080), the proxy (:8888, strangler.order.enabled flag arrives at S8), or this service's own port once it is wired in standalone. Scenarios 1-4 and every other Context Contract folder also run unchanged against this baseUrl once the order service owns checkout end-to-end. The collection itself must NOT change to target this file (that is the equivalence gate, DRQ-014); update baseUrl here (and/or point it at the Camel strangler proxy's order route) once S8/S9 stand the cutover up. This is the LAST forward-reference environment this suite adds for a monolith-anchored baseline (DRQ-071, order-plan S2) — after S9/S10 the suite's referent is the frozen golden baseline, not a live monolith.
